description: 2 pages, 12 short invented sentences in plain paragraphs; the first sentence has a clause comma near its start. For the player end-to-end tests.
format: Per page: `lines` = expected buildLines(page).map(l => l.text) in reading order; `spoken` = text to speak with DEFAULT_FILTERS; `spokenReadEverything` = text to speak with READ_EVERYTHING; `skipped` = what DEFAULT_FILTERS drop. Spoken text joins lines with single spaces, de-hyphenates "-" + lowercase line starts, and is normalized (ligatures expanded, soft hyphens removed, NBSP/thin space -> space).

lines: When the morning fog lifted, the fishing boats slid out of the harbour one by one. Gulls followed
them past the lighthouse. The first boat carried nets and a small red stove. Its captain hummed
an old song as she steered. Nobody on the pier spoke for a while. The water was flat and bright.
By noon the tide had turned. The boats came back with crates of silver fish.
